usage: llama-server [options] [--] [prompt]

-m FNAME, --model FNAME     model path (default: '')
-c N, --ctx-size N          context size

--- Server options ---
--host HOST               host to bind
--port N                  port to bind
--metrics                 enable metrics

--- Model options ---
--temp N                  temperature
--top-k N                 top-k
--top-p N                 top-p

--- Specular options ---
--prefill-assistant, --no-prefill-assistant  assistant prefill flag
    detailed continuation for the prefill flag line wrapping onto next line
--- End ---
